about_the_game:
Service Please: First Dinner is a playable introductory experience that lets you step into a journey starting with a small business. Day by day, customer traffic increases, core menu options expand, and you take your first steps into restaurant management. This version serves as a preview of the larger and deeper experience awaiting you in the full game.

Set up your business, make your first key decisions, and dive into the fundamentals of restaurant management. Every choice you make in this early stage lays a solid foundation for your journey ahead.

Create Your Own Restaurant

Start shaping your own business.

Design your restaurant’s initial layout with tables, chairs, and essential decorative elements. In Service Please: First Dinner, you’ll learn the core principles of design and prepare for the more advanced customization systems available in the full game.

• Create basic service areas
• Experience how layout affects customer flow
• Learn to use your kitchen space more efficiently

Expand Your Menu and Impress Customers

Meet customer expectations with a limited but carefully curated menu.

In Service Please: First Dinner, you work with essential food and beverage options that reflect your restaurant’s identity. By understanding the fundamentals of menu management, you’ll be ready for the broader content offered in the full game.

• Unlock your first recipes
• Learn to balance your menu
• Practice reading and responding to customer demands

Manage Your Staff, Boost Performance

At the heart of every restaurant is teamwork.

In Service Please: First Dinner, you’ll manage a limited number of staff members, learning how to assign tasks and maintain a smooth service flow. Smart decisions make all the difference during busy hours.

• Experience the basics of staff management
• Balance service speed with customer satisfaction
• Get familiar with stock and preparation processes

Shape Your Progress with Tasks and Skills

Complete your first management objectives.

The tasks available in Service Please: First Dinner help you understand the game’s mechanics and shape your management approach. Core elements of the skill system offer a glimpse into the deeper progression awaiting you later.

• Complete your first tasks
• Learn how the progression system works
• Build the foundation of your management style

Bring Gameplay to Life with Events

Witness special moments that energize your restaurant atmosphere.

The limited events featured in Service Please: First Dinner allow you to observe customer behavior and restaurant pacing from different perspectives.

• Fulfill special customer requests
• Observe how the restaurant’s tempo changes
• Discover the foundations of larger events

Whether you want to learn the basics of running a small café or prepare yourself for managing a bustling restaurant…
Service Please: First Dinner offers a smooth, educational, and satisfying introduction—designed to familiarize you with the core mechanics before stepping into the full depth of the complete management experience.
